propositions: Partial-clone test fixtures consume >32 seconds per xdist worker due to >100MiB object creation and duplication.
Protocol negotiation, missing-object, and reconvergence test cases are size-independent and can use small isolated fixtures instead of large repository clones.

A retained large-object guard (>140 MiB incompressible blob) is required to verify filter:blob:none negotiation and distinguish filtered from full history; this cannot be replaced by mocks or configuration inspection.

Isolated ephemeral fixtures with explicit per-worker teardown (no shared mutable server state across concurrent workers) reduce total setup time by 85.2% and pytest wall time by 69.5% while maintaining real Git protocol coverage.
